meta.title: Exploring Regional Warming Under Different Climate Scenarios
meta.method: Monthly tas (K), native-grid areacella area weights; cells selected by latitude center, land and ocean included; annual means weighted by days per month; subtract each model-region 1995–2014 mean of annual means. Scenario and period comparisons use equal weights per model and per year.
meta.limitations: Three availability-selected models, one realization each, not a representative or complete CMIP6 ensemble. Selected-model min–max is not a confidence interval. Latitude bands are not countries. Scenarios are conditional projections, not forecasts. Baseline is recent history, not preindustrial.
